{"id":1972324102,"question_id":3974,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1775631548,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"98 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1972324102/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"XOR After Range Multiplication Queries I","memory":"169.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    const int mod = 1e9+7;\n    using ll = long long;\n\n    int xorAfterQueries(vector<int>& nums, vector<vector<int>>& queries) {\n        for(auto it : queries)\n        {\n            ll left = it[0];\n            ll right = it[1];\n            ll k = it[2];\n            ll val = it[3];\n\n            for(int i = left ; i<=right ; i+=k) nums[i] = ((ll)nums[i] * (ll)val) % mod;\n        }\n\n        ll ans = 0;\n        for(auto it : nums) ans ^= it;\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"xor-after-range-multiplication-queries-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1914}
